name: False Hope
source:
"You are having inconsistent memories. You seem to have forgotten things you should know, or remember things that haven't happened yet. Why is that? What's wrong here? Something's not right..."

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/false-hope]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你的记忆不一致，你似乎忘记了应该知道的事情，或者记住了还没有发生的事情。这是为什么？这里出了什么问题？有什么地方不对劲……”

[来自[url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/false-hope]itch.io[/url]]
